items.text: Trim the bush to the left of the front door and the small rose bush.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Trim two small shrubs, bag clippings.

items.text: Reinstall the downspout on the left side of the house — it's laying on the ground. Add a downspout extension.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Re-hang existing downspout, strap it, add extension. Material is the extension.

items.text: Clean up the trees, bushes and weeds touching and growing into the carport.
items.priceBasis: Est. 120 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $72. Cut back saplings and brush around and inside the carport, haul to the curb.

items.text: Clean up the fence line on both sides.
items.priceBasis: Est. 120 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $72. Weed-whack and cut back both fence lines, ~1 hr per side.

items.text: Clean out the inside of the house — minor, less than 5 yards.
items.priceBasis: Est. 180 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $108. Load out under 5 yards of debris; dumpster/dump fee left for you to set.

items.text: Touch up paint throughout the house, patch holes.
items.priceBasis: Est. 300 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $179. Patch and touch up small holes and scuffs room by room, two coats; paint match left blank.

items.text: Turn cleaning throughout the house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 420 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $250. One full day for a 2-bed, 1-bath turn clean.

items.text: Install new flooring in the living room and hallway.
items.priceBasis: Est. 840 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $500. Roughly 2 person-days: pull old laminate, prep, lay ~300 sq ft, trim out. Material depends on product and square footage.

items.text: Demo the countertop and cabinets. Install new cabinets, new countertop, sink and faucet.
items.priceBasis: Est. 720 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $429. Demo 2 hr, hang/set cabinets 6 hr, countertop 2 hr, sink and faucet hookup 2 hr. Cabinet/counter material left for you to spec.

items.text: Install new stove and new fridge.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. Gas stove hookup and leak check plus set the fridge. Appliance cost left blank.

items.text: Remove the old paint cans and other old items from the back laundry area.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Carry out paint cans and junk from one small area.

items.text: Patch the hole in the hallway closet door, install a doorknob.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Fill/patch door 25 min, install passage knob 20 min. Material is knob plus filler.

items.text: Install a carbon monoxide (CO) detector in the hallway outside the bedrooms.
Reinstall the bathroom door — it's off the hinges.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Rehang door on existing hinges, adjust to latch.

items.text: Tighten the toilet seat.
Make the trim around the shower head fit snugly against the wall.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Reseat or swap the shower arm flange.

items.text: Recaulk the tub.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. Strip old caulk, clean, recaulk tub-to-wall and tub-to-floor.

items.text: Replace the medicine cabinet — mirror is cracked.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Remove old surface-mount cabinet, hang new one. Cabinet size/price left blank.

items.text: Replace the bent, broken window blinds.
items.priceBasis: Est. 15 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $9. Pull old blind, mount new one. Blind size left blank.

items.text: Replace the bedroom door.
Reinstall the closet door — it's off the track.
items.priceBasis: Est. 20 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $12. Reset bifold doors on track and pivots.

items.text: Repair the holes in the walls.
Replace the cover plate on the outlet.
items.priceBasis: Est. 5 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $3. Swap one cover plate.

items.text: Put the closet door back on its hinges.
items.priceBasis: Est. 20 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $12. Rehang the loose bifold panel and adjust.

items.text: Replace the bedroom door.
Install a door stop behind the bedroom door.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Screw in one door stop.

items.text: Install two window screens.

questions.text: Did I put the keys back?
